primitives.note: Six shotguns (legs), each fires once on Urgot's next on-hit attack within its arc, then goes on its own cooldown (30s at level 1 down to 2.5s at level 18). Only one leg is ever aimed at a stationary single dummy, so it behaves as one recurring charge gated by that per-leg cooldown.
Echoing Flames damage includes a component scaling with the target's maximum health (capped vs monsters, uncapped vs champions/dummy).
Corrosive Charge (delayed AoE explosion), Disdain's dash hit, and Fear Beyond Death's initial chem-drill each deal a single on-cast/on-delay damage instance on cooldown.
All four abilities cost mana (Q flat 70, W 40->0 by rank, E 60->100 by rank, R flat 100); over a 15s fight with a finite mana pool this limits how many casts/how long Purge can be sustained.
Purge overrides Urgot's attack speed with a fixed 3.0 attacks/second for its duration, independent of his normal (item/stat-driven) attack speed.
Each Purge shot deals its own modified physical damage (12 + %AD) and applies on-hit/on-attack effects at 50% effectiveness; cannot crit.

Purge is a 4s (25000s at max rank) effect that recasts to end, and auto-recasts if not manually ended before max rank. Fear Beyond Death has a separate, differently-timed recast (Mercy) once the target crosses a health threshold.

Mercy's recast unconditionally kills the leashed target once the channel completes, regardless of their current health (bypassing normal damage/resist calculation), available once they are at or below 25% missing... i.e. 25% of maximum health remaining.
Disdain's shield (base + bonus AD + bonus HP ratio) is read only in the survival fight, not the damage fight.

needsBespoke.why: Fear Beyond Death's recast (Mercy) is not a damage number at all: after a channel it unconditionally sets the target's health to 0 (an instant, unresistable kill) rather than dealing a computable physical/true-damage amount, except for edge cases like Undying Rage which floor it at 1 HP instead. None of the closed primitives (including execute-or-threshold, which implies a bonus-damage step) cleanly express an unconditional non-damage kill; the simulator needs bespoke logic to decide how/whether to model this against a target dummy that starts at full HP and may never cross the 25%-remaining-health gate that unlocks the recast within a 15s window.

unsettled.question: During a single (pre-max-rank) 4-second Purge activation at 3.0 fixed attacks/second, does Urgot fire 12 shots (4 x 3, straightforward math) or 13 shots (as explicitly stated in the wiki notes)?
options: 13 shots (per wiki note 'Urgot will attack 13 times')
quotes: Before maximum rank, if continuously attacking without being interrupted or interrupting or canceling the cast, '''Urgot''' will attack 13 times.

unsettled.question: How should the simulator model Fear Beyond Death's Mercy recast against a target dummy: as an unconditional instant kill once triggerable (ending the damage fight immediately), as a large true-damage burst approximating 'current health,' or as never triggering because the dummy's health rarely crosses the 25%-remaining threshold within a 15s window?
options: Treat as instant kill / zero remaining health once the 25% threshold and 1.5s(or 1s) channel complete
Approximate as a damage instance equal to the dummy's current HP
Exclude Mercy from the damage-fight simulation entirely and only count the initial cast's physical damage
quotes: Upon completing the channel, the target is {{ccs|{{tip|execute|executed}}|true}}.
The target will die regardless of their {{as|'''current''' health}} once the recast's chains hit, even if they are {{tip|heal|healed}}.

unsettled.question: Mercy's channel duration before the execute lands: is it 1.5 seconds (wiki description) or 1.0 second (bin's RChannelTimeReel)?
quotes: channels for {{fd|1.5}} seconds once they latch on

unsettled.question: When Corrosive Charge or Disdain is cast while Purge is active, does Purge merely pause firing for the stated 0.05s/1.25s and then resume its remaining duration/shot count, or does the cast end/reset the Purge activation (losing remaining attacks)?
options: Purge pauses briefly then resumes, preserving total shots for that activation
Casting another ability cancels/ends the current Purge activation early
quotes: ''Corrosive Charge'' prevents {{ai|Purge|Urgot}} from firing for {{fd|0.05}} seconds after the cast time.
{{ai|Purge|Urgot}} can be cast during the dash.

proposal: If Fear Beyond Death (R) is off cooldown at the start, cast it immediately for its upfront physical damage and to mark/leash the target (the execute recast likely will not be available yet on a full-health dummy).
Cast Corrosive Charge (Q) next for its delayed AoE physical damage and to (re)apply the mark.
Cast Disdain (E) to dash in (or through) the target for its physical damage, shield, and to refresh the mark, closing to melee range.

Activate Purge (W) to auto-attack at fixed 3.0 attacks/second for its duration, prioritizing the marked target and letting every shot apply on-hit effects and consume the currently-facing Echoing Flames shotgun charge when it's off its per-leg cooldown.
Recast Q and E again the instant each comes off cooldown, accepting the brief (0.05s/1.25s) pause each causes to Purge's shots, then re-toggle/re-cast Purge whenever it is not already running.
Between Purge windows and spell cooldowns, basic-attack normally so Echoing Flames and any on-hit effects keep triggering.
If the dummy's health ever drops to or below 25% remaining within the 15s window, recast Fear Beyond Death (Mercy) to attempt the guaranteed execute and end the fight.
Repeat the Q -> E -> Purge cycle for the remainder of the 15 seconds, keeping mana spend in mind since Q/E/R all draw from the same pool.
questions: At the simulated level/rank distribution, is Urgot's ultimate assumed to be up at the start of the 15s window, or on cooldown from a prior engagement (its 100-70s cooldown makes a second cast within the window essentially impossible)?
Should the rotation assume max-rank Purge (indefinite toggle) is reachable at the tested level, changing it from a recastable 4s burst into a sustained always-on autoattack mode for the whole fight?

Given Purge only delays rather than cancels on other casts, is it optimal to keep Purge running continuously and simply weave Q/E into it, rather than treating Purge as a discrete 4-second cooldown ability in the rotation?

Is it realistic within a 15s single-target dummy fight for the target's health to ever cross the 25%-remaining threshold needed for the Mercy execute, or should the proposal drop step 7 entirely for most build/level combinations?
